summary: Sibanye Stillwater Ltd filed a Form 6-K, a routine report of a foreign private issuer pursuant to Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, providing a market release dated June 3, 2026. The filing includes a market release exhibit but no specific event triggering a special situation category. The content consists of standard cover-page information, signatures, and a graphic exhibit. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is indicated. This is a routine current report with no special-situation event.
